title: Technology Licensing Opportunity: Room-Temperature Electrochemical Metallization of Rare Earth Elements
description: Note: This is a technology licensing opportunity. No procurement, grants, or funding opportunities are associated with this notice. Room-Temperature Electrochemical Metallization of Rare Earth Elements A low-energy, low-hazard alternative to molten-salt electrolysis for sustainable REE production. Technology Summary This invention introduces a method to produce metallic rare earth elements (REEs) through room-temperature electrometallization in anhydrous electrolytes. By leveraging unique ion-pairing interactions, Lewis acid-base chemistry, and interfacial structuring, the system enables efficient REE reduction and stable metal formation without the extreme energy use or toxic byproducts of conventional fused salt electrolysis. Problem Addressed High cost & regulatory barriers: Current molten-salt electrolysis (600�1200 �C) generates toxic HF gas and rare earth fluoride waste, triggering costly EPA and OSHA compliance requirements. Environmental impact: Legacy processes produce hazardous waste with long-term contamination risks, leading to industry abandonment in North America. Supply chain dependence: Metallic REEs are only produced at scale in China, creating vulnerabilities for U.S. manufacturers and defense applications. Solution The invention replaces high-temperature fused salt electrolysis with an ambient-temperature electrochemical process. The approach integrates three synergistic innovations: Tuned electrolyte nucleophilicity � enabling more efficient reduction pathways. Lewis acid-base coordination control � stabilizing the ligand environment during deposition. Interfacial electrochemical structuring � improving reaction kinetics and metal stability. This combination allows REE electrodeposition at room temperature, reducing both energy demand and hazardous byproduct formation. This invention enables dual functionality, electrodeposition and (in-situ) electrorefining. Key Advantages Lower energy consumption � eliminates the need for 600�1200 �C molten salt processes. Reduced environmental liabilities � avoids HF gas emissions and toxic fluoride salt accumulation. Safer operations � circumvents EPA and RCRA compliance barriers tied to FSE. Domestic supply potential � enables North American REE production for critical industries. Scalable platform � adaptable to multiple REEs including neodymium, samarium, dysprosium, and terbium. Market Applications Permanent magnets � essential for EV traction motors, wind turbines, and energy-efficient refrigeration. Defense systems � critical components for satellites, communication devices, and advanced weapons. Lightweight alloys � enhancing aerospace and automotive materials. Electronics � miniaturized devices requiring REE-based components. Battery technologies � advanced REE-containing chemistries for high-performance storage.

ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The contemplated scope consists of complete Design-Build services�including geotechnical verification, site preparation, civil works, architectural and engineering design after award, structural construction, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP), specialized HVAC/fire suppression, Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance coverage, and Furniture, Fixtures, & Equipment (FF&E). Building 112 Material Warehouse Bulk staging, overhead crane/hoist accommodations, heavy equipment ingress/egress ramps. Building 113 Customs Warehouse Secure bonded holding areas, host-nation customs inspection layout, physical security infrastructure. Building 114 Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) Warehouse Secondary containment, explosion-proof electrical systems, specialized foam/water fire suppression, environmental drainage controls. Building 111 Medicine & Medical Supplies Warehouse Temperature/humidity-controlled storage (cold chain capability), pharmaceutical-grade clean finishings, backup power integration. Building 120 DIRNOTEMAT & Quality Control Building Administrative offices, testing and quality inspection laboratories, specialized testing benches, IT/telecom infrastructure. Site & Ancillary Works Infrastructure & Integration Site grading, structural fill, perimeter security, access roads, utility connections, complete FF&E packages, and host-nation compliant permitting. 7. SOURCES SOUGHT: The purpose of this source sought is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of contractors who have the capabilities to complete and perform contracts of this magnitude, and to address any questions, recommendations or concerns from Industry. The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among potential pool of responsible contractors. Prior Government contract work is not required for submitting a response under this Sources Sought announcement. title: Forprosjekt - Nytt vassverk i Arabygdi
description: Vinje kommune ønskjer bistand til å utarbeide eit komplett forprosjekt for nytt vassverk i Arabygdi. Dagens vassverk har eit vassmagasin på om lag 1 m³. Eksisterande vassverk og tilhøyrande borehol har problem med påvising av E. coli ved større nedbørsmengder. Kommunen ønskjer derfor å utbetre vassforsyningsanlegget, inkludert borehola, og etablere ei trygg, robust og framtidsretta løysing. Forprosjektet skal gi kommunen eit godt teknisk og økonomisk avgjerdsgrunnlag. Rådgjevaren skal vurdere og tilrå plassering og type vassverk, nødvendig kapasitet og vassbehandling, type og storleik på bygg og vassbasseng, samt type og kapasitet på pumper og anna teknisk utstyr. Forprosjektet skal også omfatte vurdering av eksisterande borehol, eventuelle nye borehol, forslag til ny VA-trasé og nødvendige omleggingar av eksisterande leidningsnett. Det skal særleg vurderast om vassverket bør plasserast høgare i terrenget for å redusere eller unngå pumping til bustadene øvst på Farastadhaugen. Forprosjektet skal vidare vurdere trykkforhold, beredskap, reserveforsyning, straumforsyning, styring og overvaking. Leveransen skal innehalde nødvendige undersøkingar, berekningar, teikningar, kostnadsoverslag og ei grunngitt tilråding. Forprosjektet skal ha eit detaljnivå som gjer kommunen i stand til å velje løysing og planleggje vidare prosjektering og gjennomføring

title: Netherlands – Surveillance and security systems and devices – Vervanging en uitbreiding camera’s publieke domein en beheer en onderhoud gehele cameratoezichtsysteem – Gemeente Maastricht
description: Gemeente Maastricht is verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en leefbaar houden van de stad. Dit gebeurt onder meer door de inzet van cameratoezicht. Waar het cameratoezicht voorheen versnipperd plaatsvond binnen de gemeentelijke organisatie, is de laatste jaren gestreefd het cameratoezicht centraal te organiseren. Dit vergemakkelijkt het beheren en beheersen van de omgeving en het waarborgen van de continuïteit en werking van cameratoezicht. Vooral op het gebied van software zijn belangrijke stappen gezet. Zo is het grootste gedeelte van de camera's inmiddels aangesloten op het generieke videomanagementsysteem (VMS). Het doel van de Opdrachtgever is het afsluiten van één (1) raamovereenkomst met één (1) ondernemer (Opdrachtnemer) voor de duur van vier (4) jaren voor het aanschaffen, installeren, beheren en onderhouden van camera's conform de meest recente wet- en regelgeving (Nederlandse wetgeving), aangevuld met de raamovereenkomst tussen Opdrachtgever en Opdrachtnemer. Onderdeel van deze raamovereenkomst is tevens het vervangen en beheren van een aantal werkplekken en het beheren van en bieden van consultancy/ondersteuning ten aanzien van het huidige videomanagement-systeem (inclusief software maintenance agreement). Verdere beschrijving van de opdracht is terug te vinden in de leidraad en het programma van eisen.

title: Netherlands – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Brokerdienstverlening Inhuur MIRT-projecten
description: De Gemeente Den Haag werkt, in samenwerking met andere overheden en publieke organisaties, aan verschillende grootschalige infrastructurele projecten die onderdeel uitmaken van het Meerjarenprogramma Infrastructuur, Ruimte en Transport (MIRT). Binnen deze projecten treedt de Gemeente Den Haag als penvoerder op en is daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het aanbesteden en contracteren van benodigde diensten namens de betrokken samenwerkingspartners. De voorbereiding en uitvoering van deze projecten vraagt om de inzet van tijdelijke professionals met specifieke kennis en ervaring op het gebied van complexe infrastructurele projecten. De benodigde expertise bevindt zich met name binnen de disciplines projectmanagement, contractmanagement, technisch management, omgevingsmanagement en projectbeheersing. De behoefte aan deze capaciteit verschilt per project en per projectfase. Om tijdig te kunnen beschikken over gekwalificeerde professionals en de inhuur van tijdelijke capaciteit op een uniforme en beheersbare wijze te organiseren, wenst de Gemeente Den Haag een raamovereenkomst af te sluiten met één brokerdienstverlener. De brokerdienstverlener ondersteunt de gemeente bij het werven, selecteren, contracteren en administratief faciliteren van tijdelijke professionals voor de MIRT-projecten. De Aanbesteding is niet verdeeld in percelen. De gemeente verwacht dat de gevraagde dienstverlening door één marktpartij integraal kan worden uitgevoerd. De gemeente is daarom voornemens één Raamovereenkomst af te sluiten met één Ondernemer.

title: Netherlands – Aerial photography services – Beeldmateriaal
description: De Provincie Limburg vervult een breed scala aan publieke en wettelijke taken met als speerpunten het beheer van de fysieke leefomgeving, wegbeheer, ruimtelijke ordening en Vergunningverlening, maar ook toezicht en handhaving. Voor een effectieve en efficiënte uitvoering van deze taken is betrouwbare, actuele en historische, gedetailleerde informatie over de omgeving onmisbaar. Binnen RI worden uiteenlopende werkzaamheden uitgevoerd, waaronder assemblage van elektrische apparaten, confectiewerkzaamheden en activiteiten op het gebied van in, om en verpakken. title: Netherlands – Software package and information systems – Contractbeheersysteem
description: De gemeenten Stadskanaal, Veendam en Westerwolde hebben behoefte aan een contractbeheersysteem. Het doel van de aanbesteding is om voor deze drie organisaties een systeem aan te schaffen dat grip geeft op de volledige levenscyclus van contracten. De opdracht omvat naast de levering en implementatie ook het technisch beheer, onderhoud en de ondersteuning gedurende de looptijd van de overeenkomst. Het voeren van goed contractmanagement is een ambitie die de deelnemende aanbestedende diensten aan deze aanbesteding delen. Niet elke deelnemer is op het punt van volwassenheid om contractmanagement ook uit te gaan voeren. Daarom worden eventuele modules en/of uitbreidingen van de aangeboden oplossing als optionele uitbreiding van de opdracht meegenomen in deze uitvraag. Het programma van eisen en de gunningscriteria zijn erop gericht een contractbeheersysteem aan te schaffen maar tegelijkertijd toekomstbestendig te zijn om de doorontwikkeling richting contractmanagement te implementeren.

title: Netherlands – Repair and maintenance of public conveniences – Huur van mobiele openbare toiletten inclusief schoonmaak- en onderhoudsdienstverlening
description: Op en rondom het Veerse meer zijn vooral in het zomerseizoen veel recreanten aanwezig, welke hun vrije tijd op een aangename wijze willen invullen. Hetzij op het water, hetzij aan de oevers op één van de vele ontspanningsplekken. De taken die het waterschap bij het Veerse meer uitvoert, dragen bij aan het behouden en bevorderen van de veiligheid van het meer en aan het creëren van een prettige omgeving om te verblijven. Vanuit deze taken is het belangrijk dat er voldoende sanitaire voorzieningen zijn. Om dit te realiseren heeft het waterschap behoefte aan een partij die mobiele openbare toiletten verhuurt, plaatst, onderhoudt en schoonmaakt. De Aanbestedende dienst wenst met één Opdrachtnemer een Raamovereenkomst te sluiten voor het huren van mobiele toiletten inclusief schoonmaak- en onderhoudsdienstverlening. De werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Het verhuren van mobiele toiletten; Het plaatsen en verwijderen van mobiele toiletten; Het schoonmaken van mobiele toiletten; Het onderhouden en waar nodig vervangen van mobiele toiletten.

description: The framework agreement is for the renovation of water pipelines and manholes when blocking out. Controlled drilling, pilot pipe drilling and hose renovation are not included in the framework agreement. The aim of the framework agreement is to cover the need for renovation of water pipelines, where blocking out can be used as a method, as well as renovation of manholes and re-connection of private service pipes. In addition to blocking out, there will be a limited need for renovation by using traditional trench excavation in cases where blocking out cannot be carried out. The contracting authority is planning for two call-offs per annum, with each call-off consisting of packing several measures. The contracting authority plans to renovate approx. 3,000 metres per annum and increase the number of metres during the contract period. The actual extent will vary, however, and the contracting authority is not obligated to the above mentioned estimate. In addition to planned measures, urgent orders may occur. The framework agreement ́s estimated financial framework, including an option for an extension, is NOK 415,000,000,-, while the maximum limit is NOK 600,000,000,-. This is based on a calculation of the estimated price of 3,000 metres per annum, which can be increased to 4,000 metres per annum. The framework agreement period is 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 years.

title: Provision of Individual, bespoke Community Packages of Care for Children and Young People aged 0 - 18 years with Continuing Care Needs to enable Children and Young People to be cared for in their home
description: East of England Community Health and Care NHS Trust (EEC) is establishing a framework agreement for the delivery of individual, bespoke community packages of care for children and young People aged 0 - 18 years with continuing care needs to enable children and young people to be cared for in their home. The framework will be established under the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Packages of care provided for children and young people in the home will be carried out by registered and non-registered healthcare professionals ("Care Workers") and will involve the provision of some or all the following: 1. Assistance with personal or social care, which may be defined as undertaking any activity which requires a degree of personal and physical contact with the child or young person to assist them to undertake such bodily functions such as dressing, washing, bathing, toileting, getting in or out of bed, eating, drinking, and communicating. This is not an exhaustive list. 2. Supporting individuals who may display behaviours that challenge related to their learning disability, mental health or emotional wellbeing. 3. Play activities appropriate to the child's developmental milestones. 4. Under specified and documented circumstances, assistance with medication and other complex interventions. 5. Waking care support at night-time. 6. Specified clinical interventions. 7. Specified behaviour management strategies 8. Specified clinical interventions that may need to be provided by a Registered nurse. All Framework Providers must be registered with the Care Quality Commission to deliver care in the home, including registration for the Treatment of Disease, Disorder and Injury. Framework Providers will be commissioned to provide care to children and young people with a wide range of health conditions; care staff will require specific training to meet individual needs; this will be coordinated and delivered by the Framework Provider. The services are divided into lots: Lot 1 - Standard Package Lot 2 - Enhanced Package Lot 3 - Registered Nurse Package Lot 4 - Domiciliary Package Lot 5 - School Support Package EEC anticipates re-opening the Framework at the following points: • Four times across the 5-year framework term (August 2027, 2028, 2029 & 2030) EEC reserves the right to adjust the indicative reopening schedule above in response to operational factors. Such factors may include but are not limited to: • Supply and demand changes • Allowing sufficient competition • Changes to pricing structures • Changes due to impact of Local Government Re-organisation To obtain further information, including all documentation, please follow these steps: 1. title: France – Architectural services for building extensions – Marché de maîtrise d'oeuvre pour l'extension de l'usine de dépollution des eaux usées de SILOE (actuellement 234 000 EH) sur la commune d'Annecy
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la maîtrise d'oeuvre correspondant aux travaux à réaliser dans le cadre de l'extension de l'UDEP SILOE : - en vue de répondre aux enjeux liés à la protection du milieu récepteur dans un contexte de diminution du débit d'étiage, - en tenant compte des besoins futurs de capacité de traitement (à échéance 2035 et prévoyant l'évolution pour les besoins de l'échéance 2050) - en analysant les nouvelles normes de rejet en concertation avec les services de l'Etat et en application de la DERU II - en proposant une vision d'ensemble de la solution à l'horizon 2050 (niveau AVP) L'extension de l'UDEP de SILOE S2 est la première phase d'un projet plus global à horizon 2050 (S3). Cette première phase consiste en la création d'une nouvelle unité de dépollution (S2) sur les parcelles voisines de l'UDEP existante (S1) pour permettre, à l'échelle de l'UDEP existante et de cette extension, de traiter les effluents reçus à horizon 2035/2050. La seconde phase de travaux (hors périmètre du présent marché de MOE) consistera en la réhabilitation de l'UDEP existante (S1) et en la création de nouveaux ouvrages sur S2 et sur d'autres parcelles voisines pour traiter l'intégralité des effluents reçus à horizon 2050. Cette extension comprend : - La construction des ouvrages infrastructures de traitement S2 (phase 1) ; - La construction d'un Nouveau Bâtiment d'Exploitation (NBE) ; - L'intégration des contraintes pour S2 en lien avec l'extension SILOE S3 (phase 2). Le maître d'oeuvre devra prévoir l'emplacement pour certains dispositifs qui ne seront installés qu'en phase 2, intégrer la charge de la phase 2 dès la phase 1 pour certains ouvrages, concevoir une station avec un profil hydraulique capable d'accepter de nouvelles étapes de traitement, etc. Ce programme requiert une vision globale, à la fois pour organiser le phasage des infrastructures de traitement et pour coordonner la construction du nouveau bâtiment d'exploitation (NBE) avec la mise en oeuvre des infrastructures de traitement. Le marché de maîtrise d'oeuvre prévoit des missions de base (EP, AVP, PRO, AMT, VISA, DET/OPC, AOR) et des missions complémentaires listées dans le DCE

title: France – Parking services – SURVEILLANCE, EXPLOITATION ET GESTION DU STATIONNEMENT PAYANT DE LA VILLE DE VILLEURBANNE
description: La Ville de Villeurbanne a initié depuis 2020 de nombreuses évolutions de ses politiques publiques, notamment sur le stationnement payant. Ainsi, la Ville a fait le choix depuis 2023 de confier la gestion de son parc de stationnement payant à un acteur unique pour accompagner l'extension de son périmètre et la modernisation de ses modalités organisationnelles associées : nouvelles tarifications, évolution des zonages, contrôle LAPI etc. Le nouveau mandat politique 2026-2032 s'inscrit dans la continuité de la politique de mobilité initiée par la Ville en 2020 et prévoit d'étendre encore le périmètre de stationnement payant de 8 000 places en 2026 à 13 000 places d'ici fin 2031. Il ambitionne également de poursuivre l'évolution des modalités organisationnelles de cette politique avec des modifications tarifaires, des changements dans les classes d'ayants droits (nouvelles tarifications, évolutions des zonages résidentiels…) et le développement et la mise en oeuvre d'outils nouveaux. Face à ces multiples enjeux, la Ville de Villeurbanne souhaite continuer de faire appel à un acteur unique pour gérer son parc de stationnement payant et déployer ces nouveaux outils. Le prestataire du marché unique devra, dans le périmètre de ses missions détaillées ci-après, concourir à la mise en oeuvre de ces évolutions selon quatre grands axes : - Un service à l'usager performant grâce à des outils numériques aboutis, maintenant une qualité de contact humain dans l'accueil de l'usager et un accompagnement pour les publics éloignés du numérique ; - Des outils et processus performants pour la mise en oeuvre quotidienne de la politique de stationnement ; - Un contrôle efficient du stationnement payant ; - Un observatoire du stationnement contribuant à l'ajustement de la stratégie communale de stationnement. Ces objectifs se déclinent à travers différentes exigences contractuelles, détaillées dans la suite du document. Enfin, la sensibilité des missions intégrées au périmètre du marché, et leur caractère interdépendant, justifient un haut niveau d'exigence en matière d'évaluation continue du service rendu, et une excellente réactivité du prestataire dans la gestion des aléas. La qualité de l'interface avec la collectivité est stratégique non seulement pour le suivi de la bonne exécution du marché mais également pour le pilotage d'autres missions conservées en régie par la Ville, telles que l'établissement de la politique de stationnement ou le contrôle du stationnement gênant. La gestion de l'ouverture des barrières du parking Verlaine de 238 places et de la zone car du parc de la France libre fait l'objet d'une prestation supplémentaire éventuelle (PSE)

title: Germany – Construction work of elevated tanks for drinking water – HB Lewerberg III - Neubau: Los 2 - Anlagentechnik
description: Die Harzwasserwerke GmbH planen am Standort des Trinkwasserhochbehälters Groß Döhren (Gemeinde Liebenburg) die Erweiterung der bestehenden Anlage um einen dritten Trinkwasserhochbehälter (HB III). Der als runder Stahlbetonbehälter ausgeführte Neubau mit einem Speichervolumen von ca. 20.000 m³ wird nördlich des bestehenden Hochbehälters HB II errichtet. Zum Bauwerk gehören die Wasserkammer, ein vollständig erdangedecktes Bedienungshaus sowie ein oberirdisches Treppenhaus mit Zugang zum Behälterdach und den technischen Anlagen. Im Zuge der Maßnahme sind umfangreiche Tief-, Rohbau- und Ausbauarbeiten sowie die Herstellung der verfahrenstechnischen, maschinen- und elektrotechnischen Ausrüstung auszuführen. Hierzu zählen insbesondere die Rohrleitungs- und Armaturenanlagen, Krananlagen, Lüftungs- und Elektroinstallationen sowie die Einbindung in die bestehende Prozessleit- und Fernwirktechnik. Darüber hinaus erfolgt die hydraulische Einbindung des neuen Hochbehälters in das bestehende Versorgungssystem durch Umbauarbeiten im benachbarten Kraftwerk. Hierzu sind bestehende Rohrleitungsachsen zurückzubauen und neu zu errichten, Armaturen zu ergänzen sowie Anpassungen an Betriebs-, Steuerungs- und Sicherheitseinrichtungen vorzunehmen. Weitere Arbeiten umfassen Anpassungen am Hochbehälter HB II, Nachrüstungen am Hochbehälter HB I sowie die Herstellung provisorischer Anlagenzustände zur Sicherstellung des Betriebs während der Bauzeit. Die Trinkwasserversorgung über die bestehenden Hochbehälter I und II ist während der gesamten Bau- und Umbauphase weitgehend unterbrechungsfrei aufrechtzuerhalten. Betriebliche Belange des laufenden Anlagenbetriebs sind daher bei Planung und Ausführung besonders zu berücksichtigen.

description: Předmětem této veřejné zakázky je uzavření rámcové dohody na zajištění služeb pro zadavatele spojených se zabezpečením zahraničních služebních/pracovních cest zaměstnanců zadavatele a dalších osob zadavatelem určených (dále jen „služby“). Radovi se sastoje od izrada Izvedbenih projekata, snimaka izvedenog stanja, Projekata izvedenog stanja i prateće dokumentacije potrebne za izvođenje radova i ishođenje Uporabnih dozvola te građenja. Opseg radova je definiran Tehničkom Specifikacijom i Troškovnikom. Radovi će se izvršavati po Uvjetima Ugovora o građenju za građevinske i inženjerske radove po projektima Naručitelja, izdano od Međunarodne federacije inženjera konzultanata (FIDIC), prvo izdanje 1999. u hrvatskom prijevodu izdano od Hrvatske udruge konzultanata, Hrvatske komore inženjera građevinarstva i Udruge konzultantskih društava u graditeljstvu (tzv. FIDIC Crvena knjiga), koje su izmijenjene Posebnim uvjetima Ugovora koji su dani u prijedlogu ugovora. „Uvjeti Ugovora o građenju za građevinske i inženjerske radove po projektima Naručitelja“, izdano od Međunarodne federacije inženjera konzultanata (FIDIC), prvo izdanje 1999. predstavljaju jedne od najrasprostranjenijih kodificiranih općih uvjeta za ugovore o građenju, koji svoju primjenu nalaze diljem svijeta. Isti predstavljaju kvalitetan model uređenja ugovornog odnosa između Naručitelja i Izvođača te u slučajevima javnih nabava u kojima se može očekivati interes ponuditelja iz drugih država osiguravaju viši stupanj tržišnog natjecanja i ostvarenja svrhe javne nabave („best value for money“). Naime, upravo iz razloga svoje opće primijene diljem svijeta isti predstavljaju ugovorni model koji je podjednako poznat izvođačima iz zemljama Europske Unije kao i iz drugih država. Poznavanje lokalnog zakonodavstva koje uređuje ugovore o građenju neosnovano bi prednost davalo izvođačima sa sjedištem u zemlji iz koje je Naručitelj. Navedeno predstavlja temeljne razloge radi kojih je Naručitelj odlučio dio nabave koji se odnosi na građenje ugovoriti uz primjenu navedenih Uvjeta. Pored toga, „Uvjeti Ugovora o građenju za građevinske i inženjerske radove po projektima Naručitelja“, izdano od Međunarodne federacije inženjera konzultanata (FIDIC), prvo izdanje 1999. na sustavan način uređuju odnose između sudionika u gradnji prije svega Naručitelja, Inženjera i Izvođača, podjelu rizika, način ostvarivanja prava iz ugovornog odnosa, jasno definiraju rokove u kojima se određene radnje imaju poduzeti, predviđaju načine rješavanja spornih situacija, uređuju način produljenja rokova izvođenja, dodatna plaćanja te općenito štite kako Naručitelja tako i Izvođača u ispunjavanju međusobnih obveza i ostvarivanju prava. Primjena navedenih Uvjeta dodatno osigurava da će ugovor biti ispunjen u opsegu i rokovima koji su određeni te daje Inženjeru, kao nadzornom tijelu, efikasne mehanizme kojima se može poslužiti radi ostvarenja navedenih ciljeva.

description: Municipiul Craiova, în calitate de autoritate contractantă, intenţionează să încheie un acord-cadru, cu o durată de 48 luni, având ca obiect achiziţia de lucrări de reparaţii curente, generale şi de renovare (care se pot executa fără autorizaţie de construire) la imobile deţinute şi administrate de autoritatea executivă şi la unităţile de învăţământ”, conform cerinţelor caietului de sarcini nr. 258834REV1/17.09.2026 și anexelor la acesta: - Anexa 1- Centralizator Catalog Lucrări, unde este prezentată lista orientativă a lucrărilor estimate ca necesare pe parcursul întregului Acord-Cadru precum și cantitățile estimate ce vor putea face obiectul, tuturor Contractelor subsecvente care urmează să fie atribuite. - Anexa 2 - Identificarea și descrierea tehnologiilor estimate ca necesar a fi executate pe parcursul derulării lucrărilor în cadrul acordului cadru, respectiv contractelor subsecvente. Scopul acordului cadru îl reprezintă stabilirea elementelor/ condițiilor esențiale care vor guverna contractele subsecvente de achiziție publică de lucrări ce urmează a fi atribuite pe durata derulării acestuia, contractele având ca obiect executarea lucrărilor de reparații construcții la imobile deținute și administrate de autoritatea executivă și la unitățile de învățământ. Obiectivul general al acordului cadru este prevenirea unei uzuri rapide și prelungirea duratei de funcționare a imobilelor deținute și administrate de autoritatea locală și/sau de unitățile de învățământ, beneficiile anticipate nefiind limitate la îmbunătățirea condițiilor pentru desfășurarea activitățiilor în imobile ci și la, respectarea prevederilor art. 420 și art. 421 din Legea 169/2026 privind Codul amenajării teritoriului, urbanismului și construcțiilor . Bunurile care fac obiectul lucrărilor de reparații, pentru asigurarea funcţionalităţii în condiţii corespunzătoare de igienă şi siguranţă, în cadrul acordului cadru sunt fie imobile deţinute şi administrate de autoritatea locală, fie imobile care se află în proprietatea unităţii administrativ teritoriale și sunt date în administrarea unităților de învățământ. Cantitaţile minime şi maxime estimate pe durata Acordului-cadru, precum şi pentru un contract subsecvent sunt prezentate în Anexele nr.3, nr.4, nr.5 și nr.6 la Caietul de sarcini nr. 258834REV1/17.09.2026. Cantitățile specificate în anexe sunt estimate, cantitățile efective care vor fi achiziționate putând fi mai mari, egale sau mai mici decât acestea, în funcție de necesitățile autorității contractante. Modificarea Acordului-cadru/contractului de achiziție publică, în cursul perioadei sale de valabilitate, se face în condițiile prevazute la art.221 din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare. Modificarea Acordului-cadru/ contractului de achiziție publică in cursul perioadei sale de valabilitate, altfel decât în cazurile și condițiile prevazute la art.221 din Legea nr.98/2016, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare, se realizeaza prin organizarea unei noi proceduri de atribuire, în conformitate cu dispoziţiile legii. Termene pentru depunerea/ raspunsul la solicitarile de clarificari/informatii suplimentare: A. În conformitate cu prevederile art. 160 alin. (1) din Legea nr. 98/2016 cu modificările și completările ulterioare, termenul limită până la care orice operator economic interesat are dreptul de a solicita clarificări sau informații suplimentare în legătură cu documentația de atribuire este de 18 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor. B. În conformitate cu prevederile art.160 alin.(2) din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, autoritatea contractantă va răspunde în mod clar și complet tuturor solicitărilor de clarificări într-o singură zi și anume a 11-a zi înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor, printr-un răspuns consolidat, în măsura în care solicitările de clarificări sunt transmise în termenul precizat.

Lucrările se vor executa cu respectarea soluțiilor tehnice prevăzute în proiectul tehnic, a detaliilor de execuție, a normativelor, standardelor, reglementărilor tehnice și legislației aplicabile, precum și a instrucțiunilor producătorilor pentru materialele, produsele și echipamentele utilizate. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde tuturor solicitarilor de clarificari transmise cu cel puțin 15 zile înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor. title: Health Insurance for Locally Employed Staff
description: The Embassy of the United States of America invites you to submit a proposal for locally employed staff health insurance coverage. The Embassy encourages prospective offerors to offer off-the-shelf plans that meet at least the minimum benefit levels required in this solicitation. The U.S. Government intends to award a contract to the responsible company submitting an acceptable offer at the lowest price. We intend to award a contract based on initial proposals, without holding discussions, although we may hold discussions with companies in the competitive range if there is a need to do so. The Embassy intends to conduct a pre-proposal conference. The pre-proposal conference will be held on October 28, 2026 at 10 a.m. at the U.S. Embassy Kuala Lumpur. Prospective offerors should contact the Procurement Supervisor; Punitha Ratnasingam at ratnasingamp@state.gov by October 23, 2026 before 12 p.m. for additional information or to arrange entry to the building. Proposals are due on November 16, 2026 before 12 p.m. No proposals will be accepted after this time. Proposals must be in English and incomplete proposals will not be accepted. Your proposal must be submitted electronically to KualaLumpurDTO@state.gov .It is important to make sure the submission is made in specific size and format; in MS-Word 2007/2010 or MS-Excel 2007/2010 or Adobe Acrobat (pdf) file format. The file size must not exceed 30MB. If the file size should exceed the 30MB, the submission must be made in separate files and attached to separate emails with less than 30MB each. In order for a quotation to be considered, you must also complete and submit the following: 1. SF-1449 2. Section B, Pricing Schedule. 3. Section B, Retention Amounts in B.3 4. Section K, Representations and Certifications; and 5. Additional information as required in Section L. 6. Proof of SAM Registration Offerors shall be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) database at https://www.sam.gov prior to submittal of their offer/proposal as prescribed under FAR 4.1102. Failure to be registered at time of proposal submission may deem the offeror�s proposal to be considered non-responsible and no further consideration will be given. Therefore, offerors are highly encouraged to register immediately if they are interested in submitting a response to this requirement.

title: Pre Solicitation Notice: FY27 Maintenance Dredging Yokohama North Dock
description: PRESOLICITATION:The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Japan Engineer District is providing a PRE-SOLICITATION notice pursuant to RFO FAR 5.101 to notify industry of an upcoming acquisition that will include:PROJECT INFORMATION:Project Title: FY27 Maintenance Dredging Yokohama North DockProject Location: Yokohama North Dock, Kanagawa, JapanProject PSC: Z1KF ? Maintenance of Dredging FacilitiesProject NAICS: 237990 ? Other Heavy and Civil Engineering ConstructionProject Magnitude: Between ?1,000,000,000 and ?2,500,000,000 (Japanese YEN)Project Description:Maintenance dredging of naturally recurring bottom sediments (sand, silt, and clays) within the United States Exclusive Use Area (EUA) of Yokohama North Dock, encompassing Berths 1-7 and A-L, to ensure safe passage for watercraft and support mission requirements. Scope of work includes, but is not limited to, conventional hydraulic or mechanical dredging methods and transportation and disposal of dredged material.SOLICITATION/PROCUREMENT METHOD: 1. This procurement will prequalify sources as authorized per Class Deviation 2026-O0019 DFARS 236.101-70. See below for prequalification requirements and process.2. Following the pre-qualification process, the Government will then issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) solicitation utilizing FAR Part 14 Sealed Bidding procedures to those prequalified. 3. Prequalification and solicitation are intended for local sources only. LOCAL SOURCES:a. This contract will be performed in its entirety in the country of Japan and is intended only for local sources. Only local sources will be considered under this solicitation. Local sources are sources (e.g. corporations, partnerships, or Joint Ventures [For a Joint Venture, the Joint Venture as an independent entity must satisfy the local source requirements or, in the alternative, each member of the Joint Venture must individually satisfy the local source requirements]) that are physically located in Japan and authorized (i.e. licensed and registered) to perform construction in Japan. Specifically, a prospective bidder must be duly authorized to operate and conduct construction business in Japan and must fully comply with all applicable laws, decrees, labor standards, and regulations of Japan during the performance of the resulting contracts.b. In addition, interested bidders must possess a Japanese civil construction (doboku isshiki koji) license by the prequalification due date and time. The U.S. Government will verify that the offeror has the license through the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) website at https://etsuran2.mlit.go.jp/TAKKEN. It is the responsibility of the offeror to ensure that it has the license (Japanese civil construction), and that it is accurately shown on the MLIT website, by the proposal due date and time. Failure to comply with this requirement will cause your company to be ineligible to be prequalified for this acquisition.-U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Japan District, Camp Zama, JapanContracting ? description: Předmětem této veřejné zakázky je uzavření rámcové dohody na zajištění služeb pro zadavatele spojených se zabezpečením zahraničních služebních/pracovních cest zaměstnanců zadavatele a dalších osob zadavatelem určených (dále jen „služby“). title: Belgium – Construction work – Bouw van het nieuwe station Etterbeek, met inbegrip van de renovatie van de toegangen en de inrichting van fietsenstallingen en de stationsomgeving
description: Le marché consiste essentiellement dans : la construction du nouveau bâtiment voyageurs, la dalle du sol, les gaines d'ascenseurs, l'auvent principal, la rénovation du préau et les escaliers d'accès monumentaux existants ainsi que les renforts et imperméabilisation des voûtes, les auvents de quai et les abris vélos en Gare d’Etterbeek. La structure se compose des colonnes métalliques qui soutiennent l’auvent principal implanté le long du Boulevard Général Jacques. Les nouveaux bâtiment voyageur, abris vélos et parvis sont aménagés en-dessous ainsi que des locaux techniques implantés au niveau de quais dont le toit prolongera le parvis. La structure de ces éléments est mixte, ayants au même temps des éléments métallique et d’autre en béton. Une installation de production photovoltaïque posés sur une toiture verte est prévue être réalisée sur l’auvent. Sur les quais et le terrain adjacent on trouvera 330 mètres d’auvents ainsi qu'un parking vélos de 200 emplacements. Ces éléments sont prévus en structure métallique couverts par des panneaux sandwich. Les travaux portent sur le gros-œuvre, les parachèvements, les menuiseries intérieures et extérieurs, les sanitaires, les techniques spéciales et les aménagements extérieurs. La SNCB estime que les travaux se dérouleront pour une durée de 24 mois et, à titre indicatif, envisage débuter le chantier septembre de 2027.

title: Netherlands – Building construction work – Ontwikkeling Tweebosbuurt Blok P2
description: De ontwikkeling van blok P2 is onderdeel van de herontwikkeling van de Tweebosbuurt, welke onderdeel is van het Stedenbouwkundig Plan Parkstad. Blok P2 ligt ingesloten tussen de Putselaan, Tweebosstraat, De La Reystraat en een nieuw aan te leggen straat genaamd de Emily Hobhousestraat. Het bouwblok bestaat deels uit een woon-zorgcomplex en deels uit koopwoningen. Het zorgcomplex zal worden gehuurd en geëxploiteerd door Humanitas. De ambitie is om op deze plek een innovatief woonconcept te realiseren dat verbinding kan faciliteren tussen het zorgcomplex en de koopwoningen en (zorg)voorzieningen in de plint.
